verdict.rationale: Fellow has an in-product AI assistant ("Ask Fellow"), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this kind of product. However, all MCP evidence describes Fellow's own MCP server, which exposes Fellow data to external assistants like Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor. That is the server role, a different story. Nothing shows users can connect external MCP servers to Fellow so it can call their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
